items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Maybe Papa Bernie too. I'm not sure.

ctx.x: Who was the Danish band? Yeah.
Papa Boo. Papa Boo. And I think it was Henrik Johansson or something. Yeah. Maybe Papa Bernie too. I'm not sure.
Well what band do you play with now? We're jumping around so much.
